evidence: The repro prints length_type=float64 and then fails when iterating the first batch. The traceback ends in asteroid/data/librimix_dataset.py:92 at random.randint(0, row["length"] - self.seg_len), which passes a numpy.float64 into random.randrange and raises TypeError: 'numpy.float64' object cannot be interpreted as an integer.
steps: Created a synthetic MiniLibriMix-style metadata directory with length stored as 48000.0 so pandas reads it back as numpy.float64.
Loaded asteroid.data.librimix_dataset.LibriMix directly from the installed Asteroid source tree without importing the full package stack.
Monkeypatched LibriMix.mini_from_download to point loaders_from_mini at the synthetic fixture.
Iterated the first batch from the returned DataLoader and reproduced the TypeError.
